name: Marathon Nextgen Realty Ltd
title: Marathon Nextgen Realty Ltd - 503101 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Real estate developer posts record FY26 PAT of INR 206 crore on a INR 900 crore QIP, but Q4 bookings of INR 156 crore vs collections of INR 203 crore show little supply discipline and no capacity or utilisation data.

summary.headline: FY26 consolidated PAT of INR 206 crores, the company's highest ever, alongside INR 900 crores QIP and INR 576 crores FY26 presales (MNRL share).
summary.overview: Management described FY26 as transformational, citing record PAT of INR 206 crores on total income of INR 639 crores and EBITDA of INR 261 crores. The INR 900 crore QIP was used for about INR 340 crores of debt repayment, roughly a third for existing project execution, and about INR 300 crores earmarked for new acquisitions, of which only about INR 54 crores (call also cited ~INR 50 crores) was deployed. The company acquired controlling interests in three Kanjurmarg entities (~INR 70 crores investment) with a six-project pipeline of over INR 840 crores GDV, and took a 90% stake in Sunset Spaces Pvt Ltd. The amalgamation has received no-adverse-observation letters from BSE and NSE and documents have been filed with NCLT, with hearing awaited.

segments.name: Marathon Futurex (Lower Parel, commercial)
segments.commentary: Presales rose 15% YoY to INR 466 crores on leasing and absorption; management says prices firmed about 15% YoY and rates rose 50-60% over five to six years. Inventory may take 12-15 months to exhaust.

segments.name: Monte South (Byculla, luxury residential, 40% revenue share)
segments.commentary: Presales of INR 391 crores in FY26. Tower B has OC up to the 45th floor, with the 45th-65th floors topped out and expected complete by December 2026. Tower C is built to 17 floors; Tower D is unlaunched; a commercial Tower 5 may launch in 12-18 months.

segments.name: Marathon Nexzone (Panvel)
segments.commentary: Presales of INR 104 crores. Phase 3 launched with about 4.9 lakh sq ft carpet area and INR 600 crores GDV. Phase 2 towers Antilia, Triton and Atria received full OC.

segments.name: Neo series (Bhandup)
segments.commentary: NeoValley, NeoPark, NeoSquare and Bhandup projects together recorded about INR 65 crores presales; NeoSquare received OC. Newly launched Neohome has INR 370 crores GDV.

segments.name: Mulund Millennium (commercial)
segments.commentary: Contributed about INR 21 crores presales in FY26 from small offices and retail spaces.

segments.name: Kanjurmarg (acquired, PTC/B2B model)
segments.commentary: Six residential projects with GDV over INR 840 crores; one project at 5th slab of a 23-storey building; about INR 225 crores+ of GDV to launch within 12 months. Company holds 50% controlling interest and one-third economic interest in the transit camp model.

guidance_outlook: Management expects EBITDA margins of 30-40% on the Kanjurmarg projects, in line with current company margins.
Remaining INR 250 crores-odd of the INR 300 crore new-project allocation is yet to be spent on acquisitions.
Monte South Tower B floors 45-65 expected to complete by December 2026, adding to revenue recognition.
Post-merger, around 418 acres of land is expected to come into the listed entity; management cited Panvel plotted development possibly launching in FY27 or FY28.
Bonus issue timing is uncertain; management said it may or may not happen after amalgamation.
Strategic focus for FY27: accelerate execution, expand presales, pursue redevelopment and acquisitions, scale PTC-led B2B vertical, maintain prudent capital allocation.
capex_capacity: Unsold value of the listed entity (MNRL share) around INR 6,500 crores, plus the INR 840 crores Kanjurmarg pipeline; the company said this covers about five years of inventory.
Unsold launched inventory is about INR 2,000 crores, with cost to complete about INR 1,600 crores.
Management's thumb rule: unsold/unlaunched projects need about 60% of cost still to be spent.
Revenue recognised on percentage-of-completion basis; completion percentages are shown in the presentation.
demand_pricing: Management says Grade A office demand in South and Central Mumbai is strong; supply is lower than before, and Futurex prices firmed about 15% YoY.
Futurex serves more than 300 institutional and leasing clients, including Nykaa, ZEE, L'Oreal, SBI and HDFC; leasing ticket sizes start from 1,500-2,000 sq ft.
Luxury segment inventory at premium addresses is said to be tight, supporting pricing at Monte South.
Infrastructure tailwinds cited: Navi Mumbai airport, Atal Setu, Panvel-Karjat rail, EduCity, Kharghar commercial complex, GMLR (Goregaon-Mulund Link Road) and Dombivli bullet train station.
BMC cleared 384 unauthorised structures in Mulund, Amar Nagar and Khindipada for the eastern GMLR section (about 12 km).

qa_highlights.question: Launch timelines, capital deployment and margins for the Kanjurmarg projects?
qa_highlights.answer: GDV is over INR 840 crores and could go higher depending on PTC or pre-sale model. About 10% is ongoing; more than INR 225 crores will launch within 12 months. Expected EBITDA margins are 30-40%.

qa_highlights.question: Status of the amalgamation?
qa_highlights.answer: No-adverse-observation letters received from BSE and NSE; all documents filed with NCLT. Company awaits the hearing; stakeholder meetings to be dispensed with given NOCs.

qa_highlights.question: How will the INR 900 crore QIP be allocated?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR 340 crores repaid as debt, about one-third for existing project execution, and about INR 300 crores for new acquisitions. More than 30 projects evaluated; about three shortlisted; two acquired (Sunset Spaces and Kanjurmarg).

qa_highlights.question: Will commercial share of the portfolio increase?
qa_highlights.answer: Management aims to balance the portfolio by adding a new commercial project as each is sold; Monte South Tower 5 is a future commercial project.

qa_highlights.question: Remaining balance-sheet and unsold inventory question for Monte South and the 50% share?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue is recognised on percentage of completion; sold area's revenue is recognised per completion, and unsold value is yet to be recognised. Tower A delivered, Tower B has OC to 45th floor, Tower C launched with 17 floors built, Tower D unlaunched.

qa_highlights.question: Will there be a bonus issue after amalgamation?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it cannot commit; policy has been bonus after a few years, and currently 97% of capital is bonus capital.

qa_highlights.question: Demand outlook for premium office assets in South and Central Mumbai?
qa_highlights.answer: Samyag Shah said demand is very strong, supported by both institutional sales and leasing; Futurex inventory could last 12-15 months and a new commercial portfolio is planned.

risks_watch: Kanjurmarg pipeline (GDV INR 840 crores+) is not yet launched beyond the ongoing project; launch timing relies on the next 12 months.
Amalgamation depends on NCLT approval; timing of hearing not specified.
About INR 250 crores of the INR 300 crore acquisition allocation remains unspent.

Collections in Q4 (INR 203 crores) were well below booking value (INR 156 crores) only in the sense of lower bookings; FY26 collections of INR 781 crores vs INR 576 crores presales should be tracked for sustainability.
Cost-to-complete of about INR 1,600 crores on launched inventory will need funding from the balance sheet.
Monte South Tower B completion and Tower D launch timing are key delivery milestones.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, pipeline and demand; management was specific on numbers but gave no firm timelines on the amalgamation, bonus issue or new launches, and repeatedly qualified forward-looking statements.
key_quotes: I am proud to share the company has reported its highest ever profit in its history with profit after tax of INR 206 crores for the full year.
We try to balance our portfolio. So as soon as one commercial portfolio gets completed and sold, we try to add a new one.
That's very difficult to say right now. I mean Marathon has always had a policy of declaring bonus after a few years.

growth.why: No explicit FY27 revenue growth number was guided; growth rests on Kanjurmarg launches of over INR 225 crore GDV within 12 months, Monte South Tower B completion by December 2026, Futurex presales up 15% YoY to INR 466 crore, and a stated FY27 focus on expanding presales and acquisitions, with the remaining ~INR 250 crore acquisition allocation still unspent.
